MB6-D7-01: withdrawn by its author after the screen return: No rank-2 option set survives the screen for this mechanism. Under "keeps it" two bounds are free: P(both) < (b/n)^2 (without replacement is below with replacement) and the reduced denominator divides the n(n-1) ordered outcomes. Every natural above-key error except "both draws from n-1" sits at or above (b/n)^2 (with replacement b^2/n^2, keeps the blue count b^2/(n(n-1)), second draw only, first draw only), so a rank-2 key needs that error on the n(n-1) grid and under (b/n)^2, plus a surviving on-grid error below the key. Searched n = 6..40, every b (scripted): the keeps-the-bag-size error b(b-1)/n^2 is never on the grid when the n-1 error is, so the only on-grid below error is "adds the blue counts" (2b-1)/(n(n-1)). It fails at every (n, b) where the n-1 error qualifies: n = 7, b = 3 gives 5, 6, 7 in 42nds, an arithmetic run with the key as midpoint; n = 11, 15, 16, 19, 21, 22, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 40 leave it LONE-isolated far below the other three; and n = 13, b = 4 (7/156, 1/13, 1/12, 16/169) is struck three ways under the pass-1 screener's own readings: 16/169 by the bound, 1/12 by "the denominator must carry the prime bag size 13", 7/156 by its numerator 7 = 4 + 3. Rank 2 is fixed by the slot and the mechanism may not change. Withdrawn rather than forced.
